text: Any person who, for consideration, advises another person on the merits of buying, selling or otherwise dealing in securities, or offers personalized recommendations on investment products, is treated as providing investment advice and must be registered as an Investment Adviser.

document_title: SEBI Advertisement Code for Investment Advisers
section: Clause 3 — prohibition on assured or guaranteed returns
text: No advertisement, marketing material or product description shall state or imply an assured, guaranteed or risk-free return on any securities-linked investment product, as returns on securities are inherently subject to market risk.

document_title: SEBI Mutual Fund Regulations — Risk Disclosure
text: All mutual fund scheme communication must carry a standard risk disclosure statement and must not use past performance to imply future guaranteed outcomes to prospective investors.

document_title: RBI Fair Practices Code for Lenders
section: Para 5 — disclosure of interest rate and charges
text: Lenders and digital lending platforms must clearly disclose the annualised percentage rate, all applicable fees, and the total cost of credit to the borrower before loan sanction, in a manner the borrower can understand.

section: Para 8 — restriction on unregulated lending claims
text: Digital lending apps must not claim, suggest or imply instant unconditional loan approval, and must not describe unregulated third-party lenders as RBI-approved or RBI-regulated entities.

document_title: RBI Payment and Settlement Systems Guidelines
section: Para 12 — wallet and prepaid instrument communication
text: Prepaid payment instrument issuers must not represent wallet balances as bank deposits or as instruments carrying deposit insurance, since PPI balances are not covered by deposit insurance schemes.

Consent for processing personal data must be free, specific, informed, unconditional and unambiguous, given through a clear affirmative action, and a data fiduciary must not bundle consent for unrelated processing purposes into a single blanket checkbox.

A data fiduciary must give the data principal a notice, in clear and plain language, describing the personal data being collected and the specific purpose for which it will be processed, before or at the time of seeking consent.

Before processing any personal data of a child, a data fiduciary must obtain verifiable parental consent, and must not undertake tracking, behavioural monitoring or targeted advertising directed at children.
